// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  BUILD SQL (last 24h)  —  v2.2
//  + room_name mapping: DB kulcs → HTML email által várt név
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

msg.topic = `
SELECT
  s.ts                                          AS timestamp,

  CASE s.room
    WHEN 'nappali' THEN 'Nappali T&H'
    WHEN 'halo'    THEN 'Hálószoba T&H'
    WHEN 'gyerek'  THEN 'Gyerekszoba T&H'
    WHEN 'furdo'   THEN 'Fürdőszoba T&H'
    WHEN 'wc'      THEN 'WC T&H'
    ELSE s.room
  END                                           AS room_name,

  s.temp                                        AS indoor_temp,
  s.humidity                                    AS indoor_hum,

  COALESCE(h_zone.state, 0)                     AS relay_state,
  h_zone.relay_name                             AS relay_name,

  w.temp                                        AS outdoor_temp,
  w.humidity                                    AS outdoor_hum,

  COALESCE(h_boiler.state, 0)                   AS boiler_state

FROM snap_sensors_th s

-- Szobánkénti fűtéskör illesztése (5 perc tolerancia)
LEFT JOIN snap_heating h_zone
  ON h_zone.relay_name = CASE s.room
       WHEN 'nappali' THEN 'Nappali fűtéskör'
       WHEN 'halo'    THEN 'Hálószoba fűtéskör'
       WHEN 'gyerek'  THEN 'Gyerekszoba fűtéskör'
       WHEN 'furdo'   THEN 'Fürdőszoba fűtéskör'
       WHEN 'wc'      THEN 'WC fűtéskör'
       ELSE NULL
     END
  AND ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, h_zone.ts, s.ts)) = (
    SELECT MIN(ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, h2.ts, s.ts)))
    FROM snap_heating h2
    WHERE h2.relay_name = CASE s.room
            WHEN 'nappali' THEN 'Nappali fűtéskör'
            WHEN 'halo'    THEN 'Hálószoba fűtéskör'
            WHEN 'gyerek'  THEN 'Gyerekszoba fűtéskör'
            WHEN 'furdo'   THEN 'Fürdőszoba fűtéskör'
            WHEN 'wc'      THEN 'WC fűtéskör'
            ELSE NULL
          END
      AND ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, h2.ts, s.ts)) <= 300
      AND h2.ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
  )
  AND ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, h_zone.ts, s.ts)) <= 300

-- Kazán állapot illesztése (5 perc tolerancia)
LEFT JOIN snap_heating h_boiler
  ON h_boiler.relay_name = 'Kazán'
  AND ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, h_boiler.ts, s.ts)) = (
    SELECT MIN(ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, hb2.ts, s.ts)))
    FROM snap_heating hb2
    WHERE hb2.relay_name = 'Kazán'
      AND ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, hb2.ts, s.ts)) <= 300
      AND hb2.ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
  )
  AND ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, h_boiler.ts, s.ts)) <= 300

-- Időjárás illesztése (15 perc tolerancia)
LEFT JOIN snap_weather w
  ON ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, w.ts, s.ts)) = (
    SELECT MIN(ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, w2.ts, s.ts)))
    FROM snap_weather w2
    WHERE ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, w2.ts, s.ts)) <= 900
      AND w2.ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
  )
  AND ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, w.ts, s.ts)) <= 900

WHERE s.ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
ORDER BY s.ts DESC;
`;

return msg;
